fusions.name: Heavy Drag
fusions.desc: Drags a ring of links around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, stripping 10% of their armour for 3 seconds and slowing them by 25%.

fusions.name: Slow Release
fusions.desc: Takes 2 seconds to cast a link that deals 40 damage. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Eventually
fusions.desc: Every time you hit an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 12 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 12 seconds.
